original: 襲爪雷斬！
traducao: Lightning Tiger Blade!

original: くっ……
traducao: Ngh...!

original: 何の！　瞬迅剣！！
traducao: Not yet! Sonic Thrust!!

original: 腕を上げたね、ロイド
traducao: You've improved, Lloyd.

original: いや……クレスには\nまだまだ敵わないよ
traducao: No... I'm still no match\nfor you, Cress.

original: いや、初めて手合わせした頃より\n着実に腕を上げているよ
traducao: No, compared to our first spar,\nyou've steadily become stronger.

original: 今日はここまでにしようか
traducao: Shall we call it a day?

original: そうだな。\n腹も減ったし
traducao: Yeah.\nI'm starving anyway.

original: 君も一緒にどうだい？
traducao: Would you like to join us?

original: え？
traducao: Huh?

original: ……いつから気付いてたんだよ
traducao: ...How long have you known I was here?

original: 今日は、最初から、かな
traducao: Today? From the very beginning, I think.

original: ここのところ、ずっと僕達の手合わせを\n見ていたよね
traducao: You've been watching our spars\nquite a lot lately, haven't you?

original: えっ、そうだったのか？
traducao: Wait, really?

original: 何だよ。\n言ってくれれば\n三人で手合わせ出来たのに
traducao: Aw, man.\nIf you'd just said something,\nwe could have all sparred together!

original: べっ、別に俺は\nそんなもんやりたくねーっつの！
traducao: I-It's not like I wanted\nto do that anyway!

original: 余計なお世話なんだよ！
traducao: Mind your own business!

original: あっ、ちょっと待……！
traducao: Hey, wait up...!

original: ……行っちまった
traducao: ...And he's gone.

original: また来るかな？\nあいつ
traducao: Think he'll come back?\nThat guy.

original: 僕はそんな気がするよ
traducao: I have a feeling he will.

original: その時また、声をかけてみればいいさ
traducao: We can just ask him again then.

original: それもそうだな。\n……そんじゃ
traducao: Guess you're right.\n...Well, then!

original: 早く食堂に行こうぜ！
traducao: Let's head to the cafeteria!

original: あ〜〜暑いぃ……
traducao: Aargh, it's so hot...!

original: 汗で体はベタベタするし\n口は砂でジャリジャリだしぃ……
traducao: I'm sticky with sweat,\nand my mouth is full of gritty sand...!

original: 仕方がないよ。\nここは砂漠なんだから
traducao: It can't be helped.\nWe're in the desert, after all.

original: っていうか\nよくその格好で平気よねえ！？
traducao: I mean, how can you be fine\nwearing that heavy gear in this heat!?

original: 見てるこっちが暑くなるわぁ
traducao: Just looking at you makes me hotter!

original: 平気じゃないけど……
traducao: I'm not completely fine, but...

original: 前に、今よりもっと暑い目に\n遭った事があるからね。\n少し慣れたかな
traducao: I've been through worse heat\nin the past, you see.\nSo I suppose I'm somewhat used to it.

original: 今より暑い？\n何ソレ、どういう地獄？
traducao: Worse than this?\nWhat kind of hell was that?

original: 心頭滅却すれば火もまた涼し！　って\nその時の連れが、砂漠の真ん中で\nイフリートを召喚……
traducao: "Clear your mind and fire feels cool!"\nA friend said that, and summoned\nEfreet in the middle of the desert...

original: ああああいい！　もういいわその話！！
traducao: Aaargh, stop! I don't want to hear it!!

original: 聞いてるだけで暑過ぎて死ぬ。\n死んじゃうっ
traducao: Just hearing about it is roasting me!\nI'm gonna melt!

original: うん……
traducao: Yeah...

original: 確かに焼け死ぬかと思ったよ
traducao: I honestly thought I was going to burn.

original: それにしても、すごい数のゴミだなぁ
traducao: Still, that really is a ton of trash.

original: 捨てに行くのも一苦労だぜ
traducao: Taking it all out is quite a chore.

original: ここで暮らしている人数が人数だからね。\n自然と、ゴミの量が多くなるのも\n仕方がないさ
traducao: With so many people living here,\nit's only natural that we end up\nwith this much garbage.

original: でも、こういうのって……えーと\n「資源の再利用」っていうのか？
traducao: Still, isn't this stuff... um,\nwhat they call "recycling resources"?

original: そういうのが出来るゴミだって\nあるんだよな
traducao: There's some trash that can be\nrecycled like that, right?

original: ああ、ビンや缶などが再利用出来て\n別の素材になったりするんだ
traducao: Right. Bottles and cans can be recycled\nand turned into other materials.

original: そういうゴミの分別が\n徐々に広まっている様だね
traducao: Sorting trash like that seems to be\ngradually catching on.

original: あ、それこの間授業で習ったぞ
traducao: Oh, I just learned about that in class!

original: 資源を再利用すると\n出されるゴミの量が減るんだろ？
traducao: Recycling resources reduces\nthe amount of trash we produce, right?

original: だから、自然とかにも優しいって
traducao: So it's better for nature, too.

original: うん。\n例えば、空きビンを幾つか集めて\n新しいビンを作れば、その分のゴミが減る
traducao: Right.\nIf you collect empty bottles to make\nnew ones, you reduce that much waste.

original: 素材に使ったビンの数だけ\n自然を汚さなくて済むし\n資源の無駄使いも減るって事だね
traducao: For every bottle you reuse, you avoid\npolluting nature, and you cut down on\nwasting resources as well.

original: でもさ、\nそれって本当にいい事なのか？
traducao: Still,\nis that really such a good thing?

original: いい事だから\nみんなやってんだろ？
traducao: Everyone's doing it because\nit's a good thing, right?

original: だってさ、その再利用ってのも\n燃料とか費用がかかんだろ
traducao: I mean, recycling takes fuel\nand money to do, doesn't it?

original: 同じ一つのビンを作るのに、\n再利用しない方が、金や時間を\nかけずに出来るって事はないのか？
traducao: To make the same bottle, wouldn't it\ncost less time and money to just not\nrecycle it in the first place?

original: それは……
traducao: Well...

original: なーんかさ、\n再利用っていうと良く聞こえるけど
traducao: Calling it recycling sounds nice\nand all, but...

original: ちゃんと仕組みがわからないと\n何かの無駄遣いをしてるって事は\n変わらないんじゃないのかな？
traducao: unless you understand the process,\naren't you still just wasting resources\nin some other way?

original: ロイドって……時々\n鋭い事を言うよなぁ
traducao: You know, Lloyd...\nYou can be surprisingly sharp at times.

original: お〜〜〜。\n俺、そんな難しい事\n考えた事もなかったよ
traducao: Whoa...\nI've never even thought about\nanything that complicated.

original: すごいな、ロイドって！
traducao: Lloyd, you're amazing!

original: そ、そんな事ないって
traducao: C-Come on, it's nothing like that.

original: あー、それより今の話、\n何か本気で\n気になってきたぞ……
traducao: Ah, but now that we're talking about it,\nI'm actually really curious...\nHow does it really work?

original: あとで、先生に聞いてみようかな……
traducao: Maybe I'll ask the professor later...

original: このギルドも\n人数が増えてきたね
traducao: Our guild's really been\ngrowing in numbers, hasn't it?

original: そうね。\n現時点で、既に\n３０人以上がアドリビトムに在籍してる
traducao: Indeed.\nWe already have over thirty members\nregistered in Ad Libitum.

original: ギルドの活動が\n徐々に本格化してきたって証ね
traducao: It's proof that our guild activities\nare finally getting into full swing.

original: 人数が増えれば、それだけ\n俺達が出来る事も増えるんだよな
traducao: With more people, there's that much more\nwe can accomplish together!

original: そうだね。\n単純に、人手が増えるって事だから
traducao: That's right.\nSimply put, we have more hands on deck.

original: 何より、ギルドとしての箔も付くでしょう。\n結果、舞い込んでくる依頼についても\n高い報酬が見込めるものが増えるはず
traducao: It also gives our guild prestige.\nAs a result, we should start receiving\nquests with much higher rewards.

original: ふふ。\nそうね、○○
traducao: Hehe.\nYou're right, ○○.

original: その分、危険とは常に\n隣り合わせの仕事が増えるのは確かね
traducao: It does mean we'll see more jobs where\ndanger is an ever-present companion.

original: それくらい、望むところだよ。\nなあ、○○！
traducao: That's just what I was hoping for!\nRight, ○○?

original: うん。\n少しずつでも、この調子でギルドの活動を\n軌道に乗せていこう
traducao: Yeah.\nLet's keep this momentum going and get\nour guild on the right track.

original: 頼もしい言葉を聞けて嬉しいな
traducao: It's reassuring to hear you say that.

original: もちろん、○○にも\n期待しているよ。\nこれからも、よろしくね♪
traducao: Of course, I'm counting on you\ntoo, ○○.\nI look forward to working with you!

original: あのさ、二人に聞きたいんだけど
traducao: Say, I wanted to ask you two something.

original: 生粋の悪人って、いると思うかい？
traducao: Do you think purely evil people exist?

original: 何だよ、突然。\n変なもんでも食ったのか？
traducao: Where'd that come from all of a sudden?\nDid you eat something weird?

original: そういうわけじゃないんだけど……
traducao: It's not that, but...

original: 悪事を働いているから悪人だって考えは、\n本当に正しいのかなって、疑問に思って
traducao: I just wondered if it's really right to\ncall someone evil just for doing bad.

original: 二人は、どう思うのか聞きたかったんだ
traducao: I wanted to hear what you two thought.

original: 俺は、誰でもいいところは持ってると思う。\nでも、だからって悪い事をしたら\nそれは許されちゃいけないと思う
traducao: I think everyone has good in them.\nEven so, if they do something wrong,\nI don't think it should be forgiven.

original: そうだな。\nどんなに善い奴だって\n何でもしていいって事にはならねえしな
traducao: Yeah.\nNo matter how good of a guy you are,\nit doesn't mean you can do anything.

original: ……じゃあ、その「善い奴」が\n善い事をする為に、\n悪事に手を染めていたら？
traducao: ...Then what if that "good guy" turned\nto evil deeds in order to do something\ngood?

original: また面倒な質問するなぁ……。\nどう思う、スタン？
traducao: There you go with the heavy questions...\nWhat do you think, Stahn?

original: 俺は……悪い事をやめる様に説得する
traducao: I'd... try to convince them to stop.

original: 過去は変えられないけど、\n未来だったら変えられるだろ？
traducao: You can't change the past, but you can\nstill change the future, right?

original: 事情があって悪い事をしているなら\n一緒に解決策を探したい
traducao: If they had a reason for doing wrong,\nI'd want to find a solution together.

original: そうか……。\n確かに、そういう考え方も出来るね
traducao: I see...\nThat's certainly one way to look at it.

original: 何でもいいけどよ。\nあんま難しく考え過ぎんなよ？\n……程々に、な
traducao: Whatever you say, but don't overthink\nthings too much, all right?\n...Keep it in moderation.

original: うん。\nわかってるよ
traducao: Yeah.\nI know.

original: （……一緒に解決策を探す、か……）
traducao: (...Find a solution together, huh...?)

original: 実は、この間……\nすごい事に気がついたんだ
traducao: Actually, the other day...\nI realized something amazing.

original: すごい事だって？
traducao: Something amazing?

original: なになに？\nどうしたの
traducao: What is it, what is it?\nTell us!

original: 実は、リヒターとジェイドさんの\n共通の弱点を見つけたんだ
traducao: I found a shared weakness between\nRichter and Mr. Jade.

original: 共通の弱点？\nあの二人にかい？
traducao: A shared weakness?\nBetween those two?

original: すごいや、父さ……じゃない、スタンさん！
traducao: That's awesome, Da... I mean, Mr. Stahn!

original: それで、\nその共通の弱点っていうのは\nどんなものなの？
traducao: So, what is this shared weakness\nthat they both have?\nTell me, tell me!

original: それは……
traducao: Well...

original: 湯けむりだ！！
traducao: Steam!!

original: ゆ……湯けむり？
traducao: St... Steam?

original: ああ。\n二人とも、メガネをかけているだろう？
traducao: Yeah.\nThey both wear glasses, don't they?

original: だから、湯けむりを使って\nメガネを曇らせる事が出来れば……
traducao: So if we use steam to fog up\ntheir glasses...

original: 視界が奪える！？
traducao: It'll blind them!?

original: ああ、そういう事だ
traducao: Yeah, exactly.

original: ……いや……あのさ……
traducao: ...Uh... guys...

original: じゃあ、二人にとっては\n暑い所から寒い所に\n出たりするのも……
traducao: Then going from a hot place\nto a cold one would also be...\ndangerous for them, right?

original: ああ。\n恐らく、何かしらの隙が\n生まれるはずだ……
traducao: Yeah.\nIt'd definitely leave an opening\nin their defenses...

original: もしその不意を、敵に\n突かれる事があったりしたら……！
traducao: If an enemy caught them off guard\nat a time like that...!

original: 大変だ！　\nすぐに知らせに行こう！！
traducao: Oh no!\nWe have to go warn them right away!!

original: そうだな、行こう！！
traducao: Right! Let's go!!

original: あれを親切心で言ってるのが\n二人のすごいところだよね……
traducao: The amazing thing about those two is\nthat they genuinely mean well...

original: 通常。\n
traducao: Normal.\n
